channel.title: MOVA Insights
channel.description: Perspective on design, development, construction, and investment strategy in BC multifamily real estate.

item.title: CMHC MLI Select, in depth: the 5% equity story and every lever that matters
item.description: The most important financing program in Canadian rental, explained. The points system, the real story behind the 5% equity requirement, and every lever that decides whether you get the loan.

item.title: Reading a proforma: NOI, DSCR, and the levers that decide a multifamily deal
item.description: A proforma is a story told in numbers. Underwriting is deciding whether to believe it. NOI, DSCR, cap rate, and the levers that separate a real deal from an optimistic spreadsheet.

item.title: From raw land to shovels: the multifamily development process, end to end
item.description: Land assembly, rezoning, DP, BP, financing, construction — the complete journey from a piece of land to a finished building, and every place value is created and lost along the way.

item.title: Groundbreaking to occupancy: how a building actually gets built, step by step
item.description: From the first dig to the final key: excavation, foundation, structure, envelope, rough-ins, finishing, commissioning, occupancy. The construction chain, one accountable link at a time.

item.title: Concrete, from drawing to pour: what actually holds a building up
item.description: The least glamorous, most consequential material in a building. Engineering, reading the drawings, rebar, cover, the pour, shotcrete, and curing — and why every step is permanent.

item.title: Quality is a plan, not a promise: how MOVA builds
item.description: Quality is not inspected at the end — it is planned at the beginning. Sequencing, inspection holds, accountable handoffs, and a defended material standard, from a builder who keeps what he builds.

item.title: Why build instead of buy: the case for ground-up multifamily
item.description: Buy a building and you pay retail for value someone else created. Build one and you capture the development margin, the refinance, and control over the asset — plus the pride of authorship.

item.title: The slow build: multifamily and the making of generational wealth
item.description: Multifamily doesn't make you rich quickly. It makes you wealthy slowly, and then permanently. Amortisation, rent growth, appreciation, tax efficiency — and the pride no spreadsheet captures.

item.title: Design as advantage: how difference compounds into value
item.description: In a market where everyone has the same land and the same contractors, design is the advantage you can't buy off a shelf. How difference, materials, and aesthetics become an economic argument.

item.title: The weight of the build: the risk nobody puts in the pitch deck
item.description: Every rendering is optimistic. This is the honest account: entitlement, construction, financing, market, and liquidity risk — the weight a developer carries, and how it's responsibly managed.

item.title: Managing a $40M construction draw: what the Hockley taught us about oversight
item.description: Construction draw management is one of the most consequential — and least discussed — disciplines in multifamily development. What we track, how we verify, and what Draw 5 of 18 taught us.

item.title: Build-to-hold versus build-to-sell: the hidden cost of the exit
item.description: Most developers underestimate the cost of the hold and overestimate the value of the exit. After building and keeping The Arncote, the real economics of long-term ownership.

item.title: Why white oak ages better than every other material in a rental building
item.description: In a rental building, material choices are amortised over decades and hundreds of tenancies. Why MOVA chooses white oak — and why the math supports the decision.
